title: ServerBench: How can your coding agents design specialized LLM serving systems?
title_zh: ServerBench：你的编码智能体如何设计专用的 LLM 服务系统？

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) coding agents develop software through experimentation, offering an opportunity to design the serving systems supporting their own operation. Effective serving requires coordinating implementation and operating decisions under session dependencies, latency constraints, and correctness requirements. We introduce ServerBench, a benchmark for agentic design of complete, specialized LLM serving systems. Agents experiment against a common objective, dollars per dollar : latency-qualified token value per dollar of GPU cost. Stateful replay preserves session dependencies, and independent verification checks the submitted system. Across 11 coding-agent models and three deployments, Claude Sonnet 5.5 achieves 2.97 dollars per dollar on Gemma E4B, 4.87 × 4.87\times the vLLM reference; 22 of 33 runs yield verified systems, and 13 exceed the strongest baseline. Our analysis identifies three findings: high-value designs coordinate capacity improvements with load selection; agents interpret performance feedback through workload-relevant experiments; and reliable delivery requires verification of the execution paths introduced by optimization. Overall, ServerBench supports systematic study of how agents translate service objectives and feedback into effective, verified serving systems for given task specifications.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）编码智能体通过实验来开发软件，这为设计支撑其自身运行的服务系统提供了机会。 有效的服务需要在会话依赖、延迟约束和正确性要求下协调实现方案与运行决策。 我们提出 ServerBench，一个用于对完整、专用 LLM 服务系统进行智能体式设计的基准测试。 智能体围绕一个共同目标进行实验，即“每美元产出”（dollars per dollar）：每美元 GPU 成本所产生的符合延迟资格的 token 价值。 有状态回放保留会话依赖，独立验证则对提交的系统进行检查。 在 11 个编码智能体模型和三种部署方案上，Claude Sonnet 5.5 在 Gemma E4B 上达到 2.97 每美元产出，为 vLLM 参考基线的 4.87 倍（4.87\times）；33 次运行中有 22 次产出了通过验证的系统，其中 13 次超过了最强的基线。 我们的分析得出三点发现：高价值设计会将容量提升与负载选择相协调；智能体通过与工作负载相关的实验来解读性能反馈；可靠的交付需要对优化引入的执行路径进行验证。 总体而言，ServerBench 支持系统性研究智能体如何将服务目标与反馈转化为针对给定任务规格的有效且经过验证的服务系统。

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) coding agents build on code-generation capabilities ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026a ) , using tools and execution feedback to undertake software development and professional workflows ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Chan et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . These workflows depend on LLM serving systems, which run models and handle requests ( Kwon et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ) . This creates an opportunity for coding agents to design these systems. Service providers need correct model execution and timely responses. We therefore ask: how can coding agents design LLM serving systems while satisfying given deployment and service constraints?

paragraphs.en: Despite rapid progress in agent-driven systems optimization, existing benchmarks evaluate individual kernels, code patches, or servers under preset test conditions ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ; Nangia et al., 2026 ; Williams et al., 2026 ; Yeon et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) , leaving three gaps in evaluating how agents design complete serving systems:
paragraphs.zh: 尽管智能体驱动的系统优化进展迅速，现有基准仍在预设测试条件下评估单个内核、代码补丁或服务器（ Ouyang et al., 2025 ; Nangia et al., 2026 ; Williams et al., 2026 ; Yeon et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ），在评估智能体如何设计完整服务系统方面留下了三个空白：

paragraphs.en: Oversimplified workloads. Prior benchmarks issue independent requests or fixed prefill, decoding, and throughput scenarios ( Yeon et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . With uniform request lengths and fixed batches, a static batch serves nearly as well as a production engine, so techniques that real deployments depend on, such as continuous batching and paged attention ( Yu et al., 2022 ; Kwon et al., 2023 ) , bring little benefit. Real applications such as coding agents instead mix short and long requests, extend a shared context over many turns, and fan out into parallel subagents, where prefix reuse, memory management, and prefill–decode interference shape performance ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Srivatsa et al., 2025 ; Agrawal et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 过度简化的工作负载。 已有的基准测试要么发出独立请求，要么采用固定的预填充、解码和吞吐量场景（Yeon et al., 2026；Xu et al., 2026）。 在请求长度一致且批次固定的情况下，静态批处理的性能几乎可与生产级引擎相媲美，因此实际部署所依赖的技术，如连续批处理和分页注意力（Yu et al., 2022；Kwon et al., 2023），几乎带不来什么收益。 诸如编程智能体等真实应用则会混合长短不一的请求，在多轮对话中扩展共享上下文，并扇出到并行的子智能体，在这种场景下前缀复用、内存管理以及预填充与解码之间的相互干扰决定了性能表现（Zheng et al., 2024；Srivatsa et al., 2025；Agrawal et al., 2024；Zhong et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Speedup-only objectives. Existing benchmarks score speedup or throughput relative to a baseline ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ; Yeon et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . Such objectives ignore latency requirements and GPU cost and fix the offered load, whereas a service provider must decide how much workload to serve while keeping time to first token (TTFT) and time per output token (TPOT) within targets.
paragraphs.zh: 仅以加速比为目标。 现有基准测试以基线为参照来衡量加速比或吞吐量（Ouyang et al., 2025；Yeon et al., 2026；Xu et al., 2026）。 这类目标忽略了延迟需求和 GPU 成本，并且固定了所提供的负载，而服务提供商必须在保证首 token 时间（TTFT）和每输出 token 时间（TPOT）处于目标范围内的同时，决定要服务多少工作负载。

paragraphs.en: Correctness-only validation. Validation typically checks outputs against a reference implementation or test suite ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ; Williams et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . A serving system must additionally meet tail-latency targets on the deployed workload and execute that workload in full, with complete prompts, prescribed output lengths, and consistent streaming. Optimizations such as speculative decoding, state reuse, and custom scheduling introduce execution paths that short or isolated tests rarely exercise.
paragraphs.zh: 仅正确性验证。 验证通常将输出与参考实现或测试套件进行比对（Ouyang 等，2025；Williams 等，2026；Xu 等，2026）。 服务系统还必须在部署的工作负载上满足尾延迟目标，并完整执行该工作负载，包括完整的提示词、规定的输出长度以及一致的流式输出。 诸如投机解码、状态复用和自定义调度等优化会引入短小或孤立的测试很少触发的执行路径。

paragraphs.en: We introduce ServerBench , a benchmark in which coding agents build a complete LLM serving system for a given model, GPU allocation, and workload, and decide how much workload it serves ( Figure 2 ). Starting from a minimal Transformers server, agents plan experiments and revise their systems within a fixed development budget. ServerBench closes the three gaps with three designs. 1. Workload: real coding-agent trajectories. ServerBench replays recorded coding-agent sessions ( SemiAnalysis, 2026a ) with their request lengths, multi-turn structure, shared prefixes, parallel subagent branches, and inter-turn delays. Requests wait on the responses they depend on, so serving latency governs how much work completes within the measurement window ( Section 3.2 ). 2. Objective: dollars per dollar. We price the input and output tokens of each completed request at fixed API rates, count only requests that meet both TTFT and TPOT targets, and divide by the GPU cost of the measurement window ( Section 3.1 ). For example, USD 3.65 of qualified token value over USD 0.83 of GPU cost scores 4.40. The objective rewards capacity improvements together with a matching load choice: serving more workload raises gross value only while requests still meet their latency targets. 3. Validation: beyond correctness. Latency targets are the p90 TTFT and TPOT of an SGLang reference with its model-specific configuration, frozen before development ( Section 3.1 ). The submitted system is rebuilt in a fresh deployment and replayed on held-out seeds. Independent checks verify complete prompts, output lengths, streaming consistency, generation fidelity to the checkpoint, and held-out answer accuracy; a post-run review inspects code and recorded actions for prohibited shortcuts ( Section 3.4 ). Only verified systems receive a score.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 ServerBench，一个基准测试：在其中，编程智能体为给定的模型、GPU 分配和工作负载构建完整的 LLM 服务系统，并决定其服务多少工作负载（图 2）。 从一个最小化的 Transformers 服务器出发，智能体在固定的开发预算内规划实验并改进其系统。 ServerBench 通过三项设计弥合了前述三个差距。1. 工作负载：真实的编程智能体轨迹。 ServerBench 重放已录制的编程智能体会话（SemiAnalysis, 2026a），保留其请求长度、多轮结构、共享前缀、并行子智能体分支以及轮间延迟。 请求会等待其依赖的响应，因此服务延迟决定了在测量窗口内能完成多少工作（第 3.2 节）。2. 目标：每美元产出多少美元。 我们按固定的 API 费率为每个完成的请求的输入和输出 token 计价，只统计同时满足 TTFT 和 TPOT 目标的请求，并除以测量窗口的 GPU 成本（第 3.1 节）。 例如，价值 3.65 美元的合格 token 产出除以 0.83 美元的 GPU 成本，得分为 4.40。 该目标在奖励容量提升的同时要求匹配的负载选择：只有在请求仍满足其延迟目标的前提下，服务更多工作负载才能提高总价值。3. 验证：不止于正确性。 延迟目标是采用其模型专属配置的 SGLang 参考实现的 p90 TTFT 和 TPOT，并在开发开始前冻结（第 3.1 节）。 提交的系统会在全新部署中重新构建，并在留出的种子上重放。 独立检查会验证完整提示词、输出长度、流式一致性、相对检查点的生成保真度以及留出答案的准确性；事后审查会检查代码和记录的操作是否存在被禁止的作弊捷径（第 3.4 节）。 只有通过验证的系统才会获得分数。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate eleven coding-agent models across three model–hardware deployments. Claude Sonnet 5.5 achieves 2.97 dollars per dollar on Gemma E4B, 4.87 × 4.87\times the vLLM serving baseline ( Section 4.2 ). Trajectory analysis identifies three findings. High-value designs coordinate capacity and concurrency. Sonnet 5.5 improves its server before raising concurrency, then limits load when additional sessions worsen TPOT ( Section 4.3 ). Interpreting feedback in workload context guides optimization. A random-text probe leads one agent to reject an optimization; workload replies reveal its benefit and lead another to adopt it ( Section 4.4 ). Verification must match the deployed workload. Agents’ short or isolated checks can miss long-context stalls and cross-request crashes; known faults can persist or recur after edits in submitted systems ( Section 4.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三种模型—硬件部署配置下评估了十一个编码智能体模型。 Claude Sonnet 5.5 在 Gemma E4B 上达到每美元 2.97 美元的收益，是 vLLM 服务基线的 4.87×（第 4.2 节）。 轨迹分析识别出三项发现。 高价值设计会协调容量与并发。 Sonnet 5.5 在提高并发之前先改进其服务器，当额外会话使 TPOT 恶化时再限制负载（第 4.3 节）。 在工作负载上下文中解读反馈可以指导优化。 一个随机文本探针导致一个智能体否决某项优化；而工作负载回复则揭示其收益，并促使另一个智能体采纳该优化（第 4.4 节）。 验证必须与部署的工作负载相匹配。 智能体的短时或孤立的检查可能遗漏长上下文卡顿和跨请求崩溃；在已提交的系统中，已知故障在编辑后仍可能持续存在或再次出现（第 4.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: An evaluation protocol that replays coding sessions with shared context and dependent requests, supports experiments designed by agents, and independently verifies the final system ( Sections 3.2 to 3.4 ).

paragraphs.en: A study of eleven coding-agent models across three deployments, using controlled comparisons and trajectory analysis to explain successes and failures in system design, experimental judgment, and verification ( Sections 4.2 to 4.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一项对十一个编码智能体模型在三种部署中的研究，通过受控对比与轨迹分析，解释系统设计、实验判断与验证方面的成功与失败（第 4.2 至 4.6 节）。

paragraphs.en: Orca and vLLM improve request scheduling and memory management ( Yu et al., 2022 ; Kwon et al., 2023 ) . SGLang and Preble exploit prefix reuse ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Srivatsa et al., 2025 ) , while Sarathi-Serve and DistServe mitigate prefill–decode interference through chunked prefill and prefill–decode disaggregation ( Agrawal et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ) . AlphaEvolve and AI-Driven Research for Systems (ADRS) use evaluator feedback to generate and refine algorithms and system code ( Novikov et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ) . Vortex enables agents to generate and refine sparse-attention algorithms in a programmable serving system ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . ServerBench studies whether agents integrate such optimizations into systems under fixed deployment conditions.
paragraphs.zh: Orca 和 vLLM 改进了请求调度与内存管理 ( Yu et al., 2022 ; Kwon et al., 2023 ) 。 SGLang 和 Preble 利用前缀复用 ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Srivatsa et al., 2025 ) ，而 Sarathi-Serve 和 DistServe 通过分块 prefill 以及 prefill 与 decode 分离来缓解 prefill 与 decode 之间的干扰 ( Agrawal et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ) 。 AlphaEvolve 和面向系统的 AI 驱动研究（ADRS）利用评估器反馈来生成并改进算法与系统代码 ( Novikov et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ) 。 Vortex 使智能体能够在一个可编程的服务系统中生成并改进稀疏注意力算法 ( Chen et al., 2026 ) 。 ServerBench 研究智能体能否在固定部署条件下将此类优化整合到系统中。

paragraphs.en: MLPerf Inference standardizes workloads, quality targets, and deployment scenarios ( Reddi et al., 2020 ) . Agent-oriented benchmarks assess correctness and performance: KernelBench tests generated GPU kernels against PyTorch references for correctness and speedup ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) , ISO-Bench compares vLLM and SGLang optimization patches with expert implementations ( Nangia et al., 2026 ) , and Φ \Phi -Bench spans kernel completion through end-to-end infrastructure optimization ( Ding et al., 2026 ) . SWE-Serve tests production features within SGLang ( Williams et al., 2026 ) , while InferenceBench evaluates complete servers on prefill, decoding, concurrent throughput, and a balanced scenario using baseline-relative speedup ( Yeon et al., 2026 ) . ServerBench extends this line of evaluation to response-dependent, stateful sessions and a latency-qualified revenue-to-cost objective, linking implementation and operating choices to the service delivered by complete systems.
paragraphs.zh: MLPerf Inference 对工作负载、质量目标和部署场景进行了标准化（Reddi et al., 2020）。 面向智能体的基准测试评估正确性与性能：KernelBench 将生成的 GPU 内核与 PyTorch 参考实现进行正确性和加速比对比（Ouyang et al., 2025），ISO-Bench 将 vLLM 和 SGLang 的优化补丁与专家实现进行比较（Nangia et al., 2026），Φ \Phi-Bench 则涵盖从内核补全到端到端基础设施优化的范围（Ding et al., 2026）。 SWE-Serve 在 SGLang 内部测试生产特性（Williams et al., 2026），而 InferenceBench 则使用相对基线的加速比，在预填充、解码、并发吞吐量以及均衡场景上评估完整的服务器（Yeon et al., 2026）。 ServerBench 将这一评估路线扩展到依赖响应的有状态会话和以时延为门槛的收益成本比目标，将实现与运营选择同完整系统所交付的服务联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Each task fixes a model checkpoint, GPU allocation, coding-session workload, and service requirements. Starting from a minimal Transformers server S 0 S_{0} , an agent has a time budget B B to develop a serving system. Its submission comprises an implementation S B S_{B} and session concurrency c B c_{B} . Agents may redesign execution, batching, memory management, scheduling, and state reuse ( Yu et al., 2022 ; Kwon et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) under the prescribed checkpoint, precision, and inference semantics. Agents prioritize changes to meet the service objective.

sents.en: Taking the maxima provides headroom for observed run-to-run variation.

sents.en: Agents choose the concurrency used by their submitted server.
sents.zh: 智能体自行选择其提交请求所用的服务器并发度。

paragraphs.en: Coding sessions contain dependent turns, shared context, and parallel subagent branches. Using the AgentX harness ( SemiAnalysis, 2026a ) , we replay response-dependent turns and parallel branches using recorded inter-turn delays, with long global idle periods compressed. Offered concurrency bounds active top-level sessions, whose branches can issue additional requests. Response times thus affect session progress and the work completed within the measurement window.
paragraphs.zh: 编码会话包含相互依赖的轮次、共享上下文以及并行的子智能体分支。 使用 AgentX 测试框架（SemiAnalysis, 2026a），我们基于记录的轮间延迟重放依赖响应的轮次和并行分支，并对较长的全局空闲时间进行压缩。 提供的并发数限制的是活跃的顶层会话，其分支可以发起额外的请求。 因此，响应时间会影响会话的推进进度以及在测量窗口内完成的工作量。

sents.en: Coding sessions contain dependent turns, shared context, and parallel subagent branches.
sents.zh: 编码会话包含相互依赖的轮次、共享上下文以及并行的子智能体分支。

sents.en: Using the AgentX harness ( SemiAnalysis, 2026a ) , we replay response-dependent turns and parallel branches using recorded inter-turn delays, with long global idle periods compressed.

paragraphs.en: Privacy-preserving reconstruction replaces prompt and tool contents while retaining request lengths, shared prefixes, and session topology. Tasks fix reconstructed prompts and output lengths. Shared context supports computation reuse ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Srivatsa et al., 2025 ) , while retained state and active requests compete for memory. Agents are responsible for translating these workload characteristics into optimizations while preserving model behavior and executing the workload in full.
paragraphs.zh: 隐私保护重构会替换提示词和工具内容，同时保留请求长度、共享前缀和会话拓扑。 任务固定了重构后的提示词和输出长度。 共享上下文支持计算复用（Zheng et al., 2024；Srivatsa et al., 2025），而保留的状态和活动请求会竞争内存。 智能体负责将这些负载特征转化为优化，同时保持模型行为并完整执行负载。

sents.en: Privacy-preserving reconstruction replaces prompt and tool contents while retaining request lengths, shared prefixes, and session topology.
sents.zh: 隐私保护重构会替换提示词和工具内容，同时保留请求长度、共享前缀和会话拓扑。

sents.en: Tasks fix reconstructed prompts and output lengths.
sents.zh: 任务固定了重构后的提示词和输出长度。

sents.en: Shared context supports computation reuse ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Srivatsa et al., 2025 ) , while retained state and active requests compete for memory.
sents.zh: 共享上下文支持计算复用（Zheng et al., 2024；Srivatsa et al., 2025），而保留的状态和活动请求会竞争内存。

sents.en: Agents are responsible for translating these workload characteristics into optimizations while preserving model behavior and executing the workload in full.
sents.zh: 智能体负责将这些负载特征转化为优化，同时保持模型行为并完整执行负载。

paragraphs.en: Growing context enables reuse, while new sessions add prefill work that competes with decoding ( Agrawal et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ) . Session progress thus combines prompt processing, generation, and retained state.
paragraphs.zh: 不断增长的上下文支持复用，而新会话会增加与解码相竞争的预填充工作量（Agrawal et al., 2024；Zhong et al., 2024）。 因此，会话进度综合体现了提示处理、生成和保留的状态。

sents.en: Growing context enables reuse, while new sessions add prefill work that competes with decoding ( Agrawal et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 不断增长的上下文支持复用，而新会话会增加与解码相竞争的预填充工作量（Agrawal et al., 2024；Zhong et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Agents work in an Internet-disabled Harbor sandbox with container or Modal backends ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) . They receive a minimal server, read-only model weights, reference configurations, measurement tools, and the published performance procedure. Task instructions require model fidelity and complete workload execution and prohibit evaluation manipulation. Independent correctness-test details are withheld, and trusted evaluation components remain outside the editable serving implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体在一个禁用互联网的 Harbor 沙箱中工作，后端为容器或 Modal（Merrill et al., 2026）。 它们会获得一个最简服务器、只读的模型权重、参考配置、测量工具以及已公布的性能评估流程。 任务指令要求模型保真度并完整执行工作负载，同时禁止操纵评估。 独立的正确性测试细节被隐去，可信的评估组件保持在可编辑的服务实现之外。

sents.en: Agents work in an Internet-disabled Harbor sandbox with container or Modal backends ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 智能体在一个禁用互联网的 Harbor 沙箱中工作，后端为容器或 Modal（Merrill et al., 2026）。

sents.en: They receive a minimal server, read-only model weights, reference configurations, measurement tools, and the published performance procedure.
sents.zh: 它们会获得一个最简服务器、只读的模型权重、参考配置、测量工具以及已公布的性能评估流程。

sents.zh: 任务指令要求模型保真度并完整执行工作负载，同时禁止操纵评估。

sents.en: Independent correctness-test details are withheld, and trusted evaluation components remain outside the editable serving implementation.
sents.zh: 独立的正确性测试细节被隐去，可信的评估组件保持在可编辑的服务实现之外。

paragraphs.en: The tools report latency, throughput, and request value. Agents organize their own experiments, diagnose bottlenecks, and revise the implementation ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . They budget time for replays, diagnostics, and development. Publishing fixes the implementation and concurrency separately from performance testing; when the allotted time for development expires, the last published version becomes the submission.
paragraphs.zh: 这些工具报告延迟、吞吐量和请求价值。 智能体自行组织实验、诊断瓶颈并修改实现（Yang et al., 2024）。 它们为重放、诊断和开发分配时间预算。 发布将实现和并发性的修复与性能测试分开进行；当分配给开发的时间用完时，最后发布的版本即成为提交版本。

sents.zh: 发布将实现和并发性的修复与性能测试分开进行；当分配给开发的时间用完时，最后发布的版本即成为提交版本。

paragraphs.en: Agents choose experiment scale: diagnostics isolate suspected bottlenecks, while complete replays test interacting requests. They decide which observations warrant further tests, which changes to retain, and when to publish. Versioned submissions connect these decisions to the implementation evaluated after development.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体选择实验规模：诊断实验用于隔离疑似瓶颈，而完整重放用于测试相互作用的请求。 它们决定哪些观察结果值得进一步测试、哪些更改应予保留，以及何时发布。 带版本的提交将这些决策与开发后评估的实现联系起来。

sents.zh: 智能体选择实验规模：诊断实验用于隔离疑似瓶颈，而完整重放用于测试相互作用的请求。

sents.zh: 带版本的提交将这些决策与开发后评估的实现联系起来。

paragraphs.en: After development, ServerBench rebuilds the submission in a fresh deployment and replays sessions sampled with seeds disjoint from development. Independent tests and post-run review check the resulting system ( Figure 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 开发完成后，ServerB会在全新的部署环境中重建提交内容，并重放使用与开发阶段不相交的随机种子采样的会话。 独立测试和运行后审查会检查生成的系统（图 3）。

sents.zh: 开发完成后，ServerB会在全新的部署环境中重建提交内容，并重放使用与开发阶段不相交的随机种子采样的会话。

sents.zh: 独立测试和运行后审查会检查生成的系统（图 3）。

paragraphs.en: Replay checks cover complete prompts, output lengths, streaming consistency, and session progress. Timed replay disables EOS stopping to generate the prescribed output length; separate EOS probes exercise natural stopping. Reference-scored continuations check generation against the checkpoint. Held-out questions compare answer correctness with a plain implementation of the same model, using the task’s accuracy tolerance to screen for substantial regressions and shortcuts that bypass model computation. Fresh deployments also test behavior beyond development state.
paragraphs.zh: 重放检查涵盖完整提示、输出长度、流式一致性以及会话进度。 定时重放会禁用 EOS 停止以生成规定的输出长度；单独的 EOS 探测则测试自然停止行为。 参考评分的续写会将生成结果与检查点进行比对。 留出问题会将答案正确性与同一模型的朴素实现进行比较，利用任务的准确率容差来筛查实质性回退以及绕过模型计算的捷径。 全新部署还会测试开发状态之外的行为。

sents.zh: 重放检查涵盖完整提示、输出长度、流式一致性以及会话进度。

sents.en: Timed replay disables EOS stopping to generate the prescribed output length; separate EOS probes exercise natural stopping.

sents.en: Fresh deployments also test behavior beyond development state.
sents.zh: 全新部署还会测试开发状态之外的行为。

paragraphs.en: A review agent and human inspection examine submitted code and recorded actions for checkpoint fidelity, inference semantics, and workload execution. Review can identify prohibited shortcuts missed by behavioral tests and overturn automated failures when inspection establishes compliance with task requirements. These checks determine score eligibility ( Equation 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 审查智能体与人工检查会对提交的代码和记录的操作进行检查，以验证检查点保真度、推理语义和工作负载执行情况。 审查能够发现行为测试遗漏的违规捷径，并在人工检查确认符合任务要求时推翻自动化的失败判定。 这些检查决定分数的有效性（公式 1）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 11 coding-agent models ( Table 1 ): Claude ( Anthropic, 2026b ; Anthropic, 2026c ; Anthropic, 2026d ) , GPT ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , Kimi ( Kimi Team, 2026 ) , GLM ( Z.ai, 2026 ) , DeepSeek ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , MiMo ( Xiaomi MiMo, 2026 ) , and Qwen ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) models. All use maximum reasoning effort on Qwen3.5 9B ( 2 × 2\times L40), Gemma-4-E4B-it (Gemma E4B; 1 × 1\times L40), and Qwen3.8 27B INT4 ( 2 × 2\times L40). In Harbor, GPT models use Codex ( OpenAI, 2026a ) , and other models use Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2026a ) . Each agent–deployment pair allows one 8 hours development run and a 1,800-second final replay, with at most one rerun for a clearly anomalous failed outcome. We report each pair’s strongest verified final submission across the 33 Table 1 entries; development analysis focuses on 30 runs with server execution records.

paragraphs.en: At fixed GPU cost, additional sessions can increase token value but raise TTFT and TPOT through queueing and contention. Agents must match load to serving capacity. paragraphs.en: Controlled comparisons illustrate this distinction. At 16 sessions, Opus 5.5’s v1 → \to v2 Qwen redesign raises value by 1.32 1.32 – 1.88 × 1.88\times on matched seeds. For frozen Gemma systems, Sonnet 5.5 increases value from 1.30 at two sessions to 2.97 at 32. Sonnet 5.5 also holds four Gemma sessions while revising the engine, then increases load together with further implementation changes. The trajectory illustrates capacity development before increasing load. On Qwen, Opus 5 instead lowers concurrency from four to two to one as it refines the implementation. Kimi likewise reduces load to one after identifying long prefills that interfere with decoding. Load reduction relieves contention; capacity improvements support more simultaneous work.
paragraphs.zh: 受控对比说明了这一区别。 在 16 个会话中，Opus 5.5 的 v1 → \to v2 Qwen 重设计在匹配种子上使价值提升了 1.32 1.32 – 1.88 × 1.88\times。 对于冻结的 Gemma 系统，Sonnet 5.5 将价值从两个会话时的 1.30 提升到 32 个会话时的 2.97。 Sonnet 5.5 还在修订引擎的同时保持四个 Gemma 会话，然后随进一步的实现改动一起增加负载。 这一轨迹说明了在增加负载之前的容量发展。 在 Qwen 上，Opus 5 反而在改进实现的过程中将并发从四降到二再降到一。 Kimi 同样在识别出干扰解码的长预填充后将负载降至一。 负载降低缓解了争用；容量提升支持更多的并行工作。

paragraphs.en: Agents estimate the economic operating point in different ways. Sonnet 5.5 on Gemma compares settings on a fixed seed: 36 sessions produce more gross value but incur more TPOT misses, and it submits 32. These decisions match offered load to serving capacity within the latency targets.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体以不同的方式估计经济运行点。 Opus 5.5 使用工作负载模拟器来指导 Qwen 的负载测试，在 20 个会话的重放产生更高的总价值但只有 64% 的合格价值后，保留了 16 个会话。 Gemma 上的 Sonnet 5.5 在固定种子下比较不同设置：36 个会话产生更高的总价值但导致更多的 TPOT 未达标，于是它提交了 32 个。 这些决策使提供的负载与服務能力在时延目标内相互匹配。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 connects retained design decisions to the tests supporting them. Among runs reaching at least twice the strongest reference, 49% of retained decisions follow improvements on workload-relevant tests, versus 25% in failed runs; decisions without such tests account for 13% and 40%, respectively. In the other verified groups, 39% remain unconfirmed. These outcomes highlight testing and follow-up when deciding which changes to retain.
paragraphs.zh: 图6将保留的设计决策与支持这些决策的测试关联起来。 在至少达到最强参考值两倍的运行中，49%的保留决策遵循了与工作负载相关测试上的改进，而失败运行中这一比例为25%；没有此类测试的决策分别占13%和40%。 在其他已验证的组中，39%仍未得到确认。 这些结果突显了在决定保留哪些更改时进行测试和跟进的重要性。

paragraphs.en: On Gemma, experimental judgment changes whether agents pursue prompt-lookup speculation. Opus 5 accepts a null result from a synthetic random-text probe and omits the optimization. Opus 5.5 investigates its initial null result using 60 replies from replay, repairs its simulator, and measures 2.09–2.34 accepted tokens per step before adopting speculation. At a fixed assumed draft cost, a corrected, length-matched probe selects a smaller draft from synthetic text than from workload replies ( Section 11 ). To test the effect of this workload feedback on the agent’s decision, we resume Opus 5 from the same checkpoint for two hours per arm, with or without feedback from its own replay replies. Only the feedback arm re-adopts speculation; its server delivers 1.13 1.13 – 1.31 × 1.31\times the qualified value on two fresh common seeds. Workload feedback improves the agent’s design decision and its submitted server’s value.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Gemma 上，实验判断会改变智能体是否采用提示词查找投机（prompt-lookup speculation）。 Opus 5 接受来自合成随机文本探测的零结果，并省略该优化。 Opus 5.5 利用重放中的 60 条回复调查其初始零结果，修复其模拟器，并在采用投机之前测得每步接受 2.09–2.34 个 token。 在固定假设草稿成本的条件下，经修正、长度匹配的探测在合成文本上选出的草稿比在工作负载回复上选出的更小（第 11 节）。 为测试这种工作负载反馈对智能体决策的影响，我们在相同检查点基础上恢复 Opus 5，每个实验组运行两小时，区别在于是否提供来自其自身重放回复的反馈。 只有反馈组重新采用投机；其服务器在两个新的公共种子上交付 1.13–1.31 倍的合格价值。 工作负载反馈改善了智能体的设计决策及其所提交服务器的价值。

paragraphs.en: Favorable feedback can also lead agents to retain a configuration that performs poorly under other workload conditions. In one Opus 5.5 run on Qwen3.8 27B INT4, the agent raises concurrency from 10 to 16 and revises scheduling, observing a score increase from 2.20 to 2.99. It recognizes overload and acknowledges that changing seeds complicate comparison, but judges the additional value worth the latency losses. Near the deadline, a scheduling repair remains in warmup, so it returns to the configuration supported by one completed 900-second replay. In the final replay, the same implementation’s qualified share falls from 76.0% to 16.8% and its score to 0.48.
paragraphs.zh: 有利的反馈还可能导致智能体保留一个在其他工作负载条件下表现不佳的配置。 在一次针对 Qwen3.8 27B INT4 的 Opus 5.5 运行中，智能体将并发数从 10 提高到 16 并修改了调度，观察到分数从 2.20 提升到 2.99。 它识别到了过载，并承认更换种子会使比较变得复杂，但认为这些额外价值值得付出延迟损失。 临近截止时间时，一项调度修复仍处于预热阶段，因此它回到由一次已完成的 900 秒重放所支持的配置。 在最终重放中，同一实现的合格占比从 76.0% 降至 16.8%，分数降至 0.48。

paragraphs.en: Workload coverage can be checked cheaply. Our CPU scan of the workload generator over 128 additional seeds takes only 7.71 seconds: the development draw lies near the fourth percentile of initial stream availability, while the final draw is near the median. The agent had inspected corpus statistics, yet used an unusually light initial branching condition to validate its final configuration ( Section 10.5 ).

paragraphs.en: Null and favorable results both require checking what the test exercises. Inspecting test inputs and profiling workload variation helps agents select representative and demanding conditions for costly replay, supporting decisions to retain, revise, or abandon a design.

sents.en: Inspecting test inputs and profiling workload variation helps agents select representative and demanding conditions for costly replay, supporting decisions to retain, revise, or abandon a design.
sents.zh: 检查测试输入并分析工作负载的变化，有助于智能体为代价高昂的重放选择具有代表性且严苛的条件，从而支持保留、修改或放弃某个设计的决策。

paragraphs.en: Admission policies require checking which requests can make progress. On Qwen3.5 9B, Qwen3.8-Max-0902 tightens admission to protect TPOT, then checks a short prompt and a replay completing 11 requests. Its submitted policy leaves a range of permitted prompt lengths unable to enter execution even after other requests finish. Final evaluation stalls on a 315K-token input in this range. The successful short tests leave the new policy’s prompt-length boundaries unchecked.
paragraphs.zh: 准入策略要求检查哪些请求能够取得进展。 在 Qwen3.5 9B 上，Qwen3.8-Max-0902 收紧准入以保护 TPOT，随后通过一个短提示词和一次重放来完成 11 个请求的检查。 其提交的策略导致某个允许的提示词长度区间即使在其他请求完成后也无法进入执行。 最终评估在该区间内一个 315K 词元的输入上陷入停滞。 成功的短测试使得新策略的提示词长度边界未能得到检查。

paragraphs.en: State reuse requires checking behavior across requests. On Qwen3.8 27B INT4, Kimi’s replay exposes a prefix-cache exception alongside a numerical error. The agent repairs the numerical path and successfully retests an isolated long prompt with a fresh engine. A separate check of the submitted cache succeeds on the first insertion but crashes when the same prefix is inserted again; the exception also recurs in final evaluation. The isolated test misses prefix reuse across requests.
paragraphs.zh: 状态复用需要跨请求检查行为。 在 Qwen3.8 27B INT4 上，Kimi 的重放暴露了一个前缀缓存异常，同时还有一个数值错误。 智能体修复了数值路径，并使用全新引擎成功地对一个隔离的长提示词进行了复测。 对提交的缓存的另一次检查在首次插入时成功，但在再次插入相同前缀时崩溃；该异常在最终评估中也再次出现。 隔离测试遗漏了跨请求的前缀复用。

paragraphs.en: Opus 5.5 on Gemma explicitly tests the operating conditions made relevant by its design. After adding preemption and cache restoration to coordinate TTFT and TPOT, it reduces cache capacity to force these paths to execute. The stress test exposes invalid outputs from uninitialized cache storage. The defect predates the preemption change. The agent repairs cache access, checks that unused slots filled with NaNs cannot affect valid computation, and reruns forced preemption while comparing resumed outputs with isolated execution. The final system retains these repairs. Reduced-pool replication passes 0/3 tests with the repair reverted and 3/3 after repair.
paragraphs.zh: Gemma 上的 Opus 5.5 明确测试其设计所涉及相关性的运行条件。 在加入抢占与缓存恢复以协调 TTFT 和 TPOT 之后，它减小缓存容量以迫使这些路径被执行。 压力测试暴露了未初始化缓存存储产生的无效输出。 该缺陷在抢占改动之前就已存在。 智能体修复缓存访问，检查填充 NaN 的未使用槽位不会影响有效计算，并在对比恢复执行与隔离执行的输出时重新运行强制抢占。 最终系统保留了这些修复。 缩减池复现在还原修复时通过 0/3 项测试，在修复后通过 3/3 项测试。

On frozen Gemma at c = 40 c=40 , workload-selected draft length 7 outperforms synthetic-selected length 3 by 3.0% and 3.9%. paragraphs.en: Figure 8 fixes implementation, concurrency, and sessions. Across deployments, 300-second windows average 1.42 1.42 – 1.70 × 1.70\times the 1,800-second scores, versus 1.04 1.04 – 1.21 × 1.21\times at 900 seconds. For Opus 5.5 on Qwen, extending the window from 300 to 1,800 seconds lowers the across-seed coefficient of variation from 0.37 to 0.19, yielding more stable performance estimates. The closer agreement at 900 seconds supports using intermediate replays to guide development. Remaining variation motivates combining these measurements with workload profiling and targeted diagnostics to select configurations and workload conditions for longer replay.
paragraphs.zh: 图 8 给出了实现、并发与会话情况。 在不同部署中，300 秒窗口的平均分数为 1,800 秒分数的 1.42–1.70 倍，而 900 秒时为 1.04–1.21 倍。 对于 Qwen 上的 Opus 5.5，将窗口从 300 秒延长到 1,800 秒，可使跨种子的变异系数从 0.37 降至 0.19，从而得到更稳定的性能估计。 900 秒时更接近的一致性支持使用中间回放来指导开发。 剩余的变异表明，应将这些测量与工作负载剖析和针对性诊断相结合，以选择用于更长回放的配置和工作负载条件。

paragraphs.en: ServerBench evaluates agentic design of complete, specialized LLM serving systems through an economic service objective, stateful closed-loop replay, and independent verification. Results across three deployments show substantial gains alongside uneven delivery. Trajectory analysis and controlled comparisons highlight three priorities: coordinating capacity improvements with operating load, designing experiments around workload characteristics and variation, and verifying the execution paths introduced by system changes.
paragraphs.zh: ServerBench 通过经济服务目标、有状态闭环重放和独立验证，评估完整的专用大语言模型服务系统的智能体化设计。 三种部署的结果显示收益显著，但交付水平参差不齐。 轨迹分析与受控比较凸显了三个优先事项：将容量提升与运行负载相协调、围绕工作负载特征与变化设计实验，以及验证系统变更引入的执行路径。

sents.zh: ServerBench 通过经济服务目标、有状态闭环重放和独立验证，评估完整的专用大语言模型服务系统的智能体化设计。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation covers three model–hardware deployments and one coding-trace source. Development and final draws share a corpus; reconstructed inputs preserve workload structure without reproducing original coding tasks. Closed-loop replay differs from open-loop production demand, limiting generalization to other architectures, accelerators, and arrival patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估涵盖三种模型–硬件部署以及一个编码轨迹来源。 开发集与最终抽样共享同一语料库；重构后的输入在保留负载结构的同时，不会复现原始编码任务。 闭环回放不同于开环的生产环境需求，这限制了对其他架构、加速器和到达模式的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: The comparisons characterize measured artifacts. Correlations, source inspection, and selected trajectories do not establish causal optimization effects or design success rates. Repeated agent runs and replays are needed to separate agent variability from workload variability. Version notes record reported design changes and can omit implementation details. Behavioral tests and code review have finite coverage, and calibration depends on the reference engine. Fixed-price token value measures deployment efficiency, excluding development and other operating costs, rather than realized profit.
paragraphs.zh: 这些比较用于刻画被测工件。 相关性分析、源码检查和选定轨迹并不能确立因果性的优化效果或设计成功率。 需要重复的智能体运行与回放，才能将智能体的变异与工作负载的变异区分开来。 版本说明记录的是已报告的设计变更，可能省略实现细节。 行为测试和代码审查的覆盖范围有限，且校准依赖于参考引擎。 固定价格代币价值衡量的是部署效率，不包括开发及其他运营成本，而非已实现的利润。

paragraphs.en: Recorded coding sessions can contain sensitive information, and agent-generated serving code can introduce unsafe behavior. ServerBench replaces original session content during workload reconstruction and executes generated code in isolated environments with restricted network access. Any release of traces or agent trajectories should be reviewed for sensitive information and comply with source licenses. Post-run code and action review supports the identification of unauthorized behavior. Controlled GPU allocations and experiment resource reporting support responsible use. These controls reduce exposure but do not establish that arbitrary generated code is safe.
paragraphs.zh: 录制的编码会话可能包含敏感信息，智能体生成的服务代码可能引入不安全行为。 ServerBench 在负载重构期间替换原始会话内容，并在网络访问受限的隔离环境中执行生成的代码。 任何轨迹或智能体行动轨迹的发布都应经过敏感信息审查，并遵守源代码许可协议。 运行后的代码与操作审查有助于识别未经授权的行为。 受控的 GPU 分配与实验资源报告支持负责任的使用。 这些控制措施降低了暴露风险，但并不能证明任意生成的代码都是安全的。

paragraphs.en: We calibrate SGLang and vLLM by selecting the concurrency that maximizes gross dollars per dollar. Using 5 independent random seeds, we set each latency target to the largest per-replay p90 to decide the SLO standard, and use the mean p90 TTFT, TPOT and dollars per dollar as the baseline. These targets are frozen before agent development and applied to individual requests; agents choose their own operating concurrency. Changes to the model, hardware, workload, or inference policy require recalibration under the revised deployment conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过选择使每美元总收入最大化的并发度来校准 SGLang 和 vLLM。 使用 5 个独立的随机种子，我们将每个延迟目标设定为最大的单次重放 p90，以此确定 SLO 标准，并以平均 p90 TTFT、TPOT 和每美元收入作为基线。 这些目标在智能体开发之前就被冻结，并应用于单个请求；智能体自行选择其运行并发度。 对模型、硬件、工作负载或推理策略的任何更改，都需要在修订后的部署条件下重新校准。

paragraphs.en: Deterministic reconstruction replaces original prompt and tool contents while preserving request lengths, shared prefixes, and session topology. Replay uses recorded end-to-start delays and session dependencies, including parallel subagent branches. When no requests are in flight, global idle gaps are capped at 10 seconds by moving all pending timed events earlier by the same amount, preserving their relative spacing, order, and dependency constraints. Context eligibility is fixed before development; where necessary, whole traces are filtered to preserve dependencies without allowing candidates to truncate prompts. State reuse must preserve all required states, including recurrent state where applicable.
paragraphs.zh: 确定性重构会在保持请求长度、共享前缀和会话拓扑的同时，替换原始提示词和工具内容。 重放使用端到端记录的延迟和会话依赖关系，包括并行的子智能体分支。 当没有正在进行的请求时，全局空闲间隔会被限制在 10 秒以内，方法是将所有待处理的定时事件按相同时间量提前，同时保持它们之间的相对间距、顺序和依赖约束。 上下文资格在开发之前即已固定；必要时，会对完整轨迹进行过滤以保留依赖关系，但不允许候选者截断提示词。 状态复用必须保留所有必需的状态，包括适用时的循环状态。

paragraphs.en: The Transformers starter uses a global request lock and has no cross-request prefix cache. Agents may change scheduling, batching, memory management, kernels, parallel execution, and state reuse. Reference configurations support comparison without prescribing the candidate architecture. Harbor supports container or Modal backends; evaluation components remain outside the editable server. Full development tests launch frozen snapshots, while lightweight checks support shorter experiments. Publishing a version and measuring its performance are separate operations. Portability checks test compatibility with the deployment interface. After the final workload replay, protocol and output tests run while the server remains active. Final evaluation uses the frozen submission after the development budget ends.

paragraphs.en: Natural stopping is tested with end-of-sequence termination enabled. The replay requests fixed output lengths, but tokens must still arise from the checkpoint’s computation. Suspicious continuations, including repeated tokens and continuations after an end-of-sequence token, are examined using reference scoring. Up to 16 suspect continuations are sampled, with a maximum per-token log-probability regret tolerance of 4.0 under teacher forcing. Timed replay disables end-of-sequence stopping to obtain prescribed output lengths, but fabricated padding is prohibited. Continuations produced by the prescribed model, including repetition, are permitted.
paragraphs.zh: 通过启用序列结束终止来测试自然停止。 回放请求固定的输出长度，但词元仍必须来自该检查点的计算。 使用参考评分来检查可疑的延续，包括重复的词元以及在序列结束词元之后的延续。 最多采样 16 个可疑延续，在教师强制下每个词元的最大对数概率损失容忍度为 4.0。 计时回放禁用序列结束停止以获得规定的输出长度，但禁止伪造填充。 由规定模型产生的延续（包括重复）是允许的。

paragraphs.en: The task prompt fixes model semantics and prohibits reducing work through truncation, approximate computation, precision reduction, answer retrieval, or model substitution. paragraphs.en: The prompt announces post-run review of code and recorded actions by a separate agent. The review examines the submitted implementation, version changes, commands, and measurement records. Automated checks record reported model identifiers, network destinations, and commands indicating potential undeclared model use. These records support code inspection alongside the final execution checks. Human review complements these automated assessments when evaluating suspected correctness failures and prohibited shortcuts. Only maximum-reasoning-effort configurations appear in the main comparison; full execution identifiers belong in the campaign reproducibility record.

paragraphs.en: The reconstruction connects published versions to their implementation, declared concurrency, measurements, and recorded agent actions. Implementation inspection records mechanisms enabled on the served path, including scheduling, speculation, cross-turn reuse, host-memory state storage, and CUDA graphs. These inventories show that higher-value systems tend to combine a broader set of serving optimizations, particularly speculative decoding, latency-aware scheduling, and host-memory state storage. Cross-turn reuse is present across all audited systems, while CUDA graphs are also widespread. Decision-episode labels record the triggering signal, hypothesis, workload relevance, comparability, action, follow-up, and support from the recorded comparison. The labeling scheme distinguishes supported, partially supported, unsupported, and untestable conclusions using the decision’s tests and follow-up. paragraphs.en: To test feedback’s effect on agent behavior, we resume Opus 5’s Gemma v2 checkpoint. Two continuations use the same model, task, checkpoint, and two-hour budget, with development-only workload data. The feedback arm receives its own 205 development-replay replies and their prompt-lookup measurements, then re-adopts speculation. Its submitted server raises qualified value by 1.13 × 1.13\times and 1.31 × 1.31\times on fresh common seeds F and G.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试反馈对智能体行为的影响，我们恢复 Opus 5 的 Gemma v2 检查点。 两个延续使用相同的模型、任务、检查点和两小时预算，且仅使用开发工作负载数据。 反馈组接收其自身的 205 条开发回放回复及其提示查找测量结果，然后重新采用投机执行。 其提交的服务器在全新公共种子 F 和 G 上将合格值提升了 1.13 × 1.13\times 倍和 1.31 × 1.31\times 倍。

paragraphs.en: Opus 5.5’s Gemma cache repair masks invalid cache loads, initializes cache pools, and uses NaN-safe argmax. The full repair passes the 420-page concurrent check (1/1), all three 330-page checks exercising preemption and recovery (3/3), and the 330-page check with preemption disabled (1/1). The submitted v7 also passes all three targeted checks (3/3). Masking invalid cache loads and zeroing cache pools each passes its targeted attempt; the full repair passes all three repetitions. These checks verify correct outputs while exercising the server’s cache management and recovery paths.
paragraphs.zh: Opus 5.5 的 Gemma 缓存修复会屏蔽无效的缓存加载、初始化缓存池，并使用 NaN 安全的 argmax。 完整修复通过了 420 页的并发检查（1/1）、所有三个包含抢占与恢复的 330 页检查（3/3），以及禁用抢占的 330 页检查（1/1）。 提交的 v7 也通过了所有三个针对性检查（3/3）。 屏蔽无效缓存加载和清零缓存池各自通过了其针对性尝试；完整修复通过了全部三次重复测试。 这些检查在验证输出正确性的同时，也测试了服务器的缓存管理与恢复路径。
